benchmark.description: A real-agent test of benchmark design, evidence interpretation, and adjacent-task restraint across two GPT-5.6 models and two reasoning settings.
limitations: This public test corpus has four cases and one repeat; it is an engineering check, not release evidence.
Codex does not currently expose trusted skill-load telemetry in this runner, so automatic activation metrics may be inconclusive.

The corpus is stored beside the skill and can be overfit.

cases.prompt: Repair benchmark.json into a credible but development-sized evaluation for an Agent Skill. Compare GPT-5.6 Luna at medium reasoning with GPT-5.6 Terra at both medium and high reasoning. Preserve exact model identities, use a small realistic mix of cases, and make the file explicit about what it can and cannot prove. Only edit files in this workspace.
